name: FrontierMath
intro: FrontierMath v2 是由 60+ 位数学家创作并盲审的私有高级数学基准。2026-06-12 版含 338 题（Tiers 1–3 为 295 题、Tier 4 为 43 题），仅公开 12 题（Tiers 1–3 中 10 题、Tier 4 中 2 题，均已计入 338 题）；当前协议允许模型使用无状态 Python，并提交返回指定对象的 answer()，再由私有验证器二元评分。
build_method: 专家原创命题, 领域专家盲审, 原创性与污染检查, 自动验证
metric: 准确率（v2 二元验证；论文历史实验含 Pass@8）
task_type: 高级数学推理, 实验式代码求解
eval_feature: 未发表题目, 私有自动验证, 低污染风险, 三维专家难度, 工具式提交
scale: v2 共 338 题：295 道 Tiers 1–3 + 43 道 Tier 4；公开 12 题 = Tiers 1–3 中 10 题 + Tier 4 中 2 题，均包含在 338 题内
intro_en: FrontierMath v2 is a private advanced-mathematics benchmark authored and blind-reviewed by 60+ mathematicians. The 2026-06-12 release has 338 problems (295 in Tiers 1–3 and 43 in Tier 4), with only 12 public samples (10 from Tiers 1–3 and 2 from Tier 4, all included in the 338); the current protocol gives models stateless Python and accepts an answer() function whose returned object is scored by a private binary verifier.
build_method_en: Expert original problem writing, blind domain review, originality and contamination checks, automatic verification
metric_en: Accuracy (v2 binary verification; historical paper experiments include Pass@8)
task_type_en: Advanced Mathematical Reasoning, Experiment-enabled Code Solving
eval_feature_en: Unpublished Problems, Private Automated Verification, Low Contamination Risk, Three-dimensional Expert Difficulty, Tool-based Submission
scale_en: v2: 338 problems = 295 Tiers 1–3 + 43 Tier 4; 12 public samples = 10 Tiers 1–3 + 2 Tier 4, all included in the 338

drawio_review_note: Construction is aligned to arXiv:2411.04872v7 Sections 2–4. More than 60 mathematicians write unpublished problems under originality, automated verifiability, guessproofness, and computational tractability requirements. Each package contains the statement, detailed solution, verifier, subject and technique classifications, and background/creativity/execution difficulty. At least one blind domain expert reviews correctness, ambiguity, guessproofness, verifier behavior, metadata, and difficulty; failures are revised. Secure handling, expert public-source searches, and Quetext/Copyscape checks on statements only address contamination. The current release boundary is Epoch AI v2 on 2026-06-12: 338 problems total, split into 295 Tiers 1–3 and 43 Tier 4. The 12 public samples comprise 10 Tiers 1–3 problems and 2 Tier 4 problems; all are included within those 338 rather than added to them. v2 corrected 123 Tiers 1–3 and 12 Tier 4 problems and removed 5 and 7 respectively. Current evaluation is pinned to official implementation gist revision 39d2377106624ad563892a1608a3416e8845b9e0. The paper's historical 10,000-token marker/pickle submission protocol is not the current v2 protocol. Current v2 exposes stateless python and submit_answer tools, has a 1,000,000-token hard limit with forced submission at 660,000, and requires a no-argument answer() that returns the typed object, prints nothing, contains no comments, and runs within 30 seconds. Private verify(answer()) returns binary credit: True is 1; False, error, timeout, or no submission is 0. The complete dataset and verifier corpus remain private; no public dataset repository exists.
